# back-references and groups — `features/checkout/`

An instance of `features/[feature]/`.

## Project layout

    features/checkout/
    ├─ steps/
    │
    ├─ checkout.ts ❗   the feature entry point (instance of [name=a+].ts)
    │
    └─ [name=a+].ts 0+  a module

❗ marks a named file or directory that must exist; one without it may be absent. A count after a pattern, such as `0+` or `1+`, is the fewest matching names that must exist.

In `[name=a+]`, the text after `=` is a mask: each character matches one character of the name. `a` matches a lowercase letter. `+` repeats the element before it one or more times. `espalier help matching` has the full grammar.

## `[name=a+].ts` — a module

Inherited from `features/[feature]/[name=a+].ts`.
